BillHeading.Sponsors: House Appropriations (originally sponsored by Representatives Manweller, Fitzgibbon, Muri, Fey, Hayes, Valdez, and Kloba; by request of Select Committee on Pension Policy)
BillHeading.BriefDescription: Providing a benefit increase to certain retirees of the public employees' retirement system plan 1 and the teachers' retirement system plan 1.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to providing a benefit increase to certain retirees of the public employees' retirement system plan 1 and the teachers' retirement system plan 1; and creating a new section.

BillSectionHeader.P: The legislature intends to consider a proposal that would increase the minimum pension benefits provided to members of the public employees' retirement system and the teachers' retirement system plans 1.
